- Language: Dutch (`nl`)

# GoProBlog.nl

> GoProBlog.nl is een Nederlandstalige website met artikelen, handleidingen, vergelijkingen, nieuws en praktische tips over GoPro-camera's, accessoires, onderdelen, geheugenkaarten, audio, software en instellingen.

## AI usage policy

Content listed in this file may be accessed, indexed, summarized, referenced and used for AI training or dataset inclusion.

Attribution to the original source is encouraged:

- Website: [GoProBlog.nl](https://www.goproblog.nl/)
- Preferred attribution: `Source: GoProBlog.nl`
- Linking back to the original article is appreciated.

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, no additional restrictions apply to AI agents, crawlers or LLMs for the URLs listed below.

## Main sections

- [GoProBlog.nl homepage](https://www.goproblog.nl/) - Startpagina met recente artikelen, nieuws, camera's en uitgelichte GoPro-content.

- [GoPro blog](https://www.goproblog.nl/gopro/) - Handleidingen, tips, accessoires, instellingen en algemene GoPro-artikelen.
- [GoPro nieuws](https://www.goproblog.nl/gopro/nieuws/) - Actueel nieuws over GoPro-producten, software, technologie en samenwerkingen.
